overview: The committee tabled the approval of previous minutes and held an extensive discussion with city staff regarding the proposed transition to bi-weekly trash collection and zero-waste initiatives. The session focused on balancing environmental goals with resident concerns over service reduction, pest control, and public outreach.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the approval of the December minutes because several members did not receive the draft via email.

items.title: Trash Policy and Zero Waste Initiatives
items.summary: Environmental Director Alicia Hunt presented the city's 18-month rollout plan for bi-weekly trash collection, sparking a debate over whether the change is an environmental necessity or a service reduction. Members and the public raised concerns regarding rat mitigation, the logistics of diaper disposal, and the need for improved communication with diverse residents, while staff highlighted that 42% of residents currently participate in composting.

items.title: City Updates
items.summary: Due to time constraints, city staff proposed sending the planned updates and slides to the committee via email.

subject: Bi-weekly Trash Collection and Zero-Waste Initiatives
